proves.claim: with PULLBOARD_NEXT_PROFILE set, next --take reports each ordered claim sub-step and the inclusive claim write total.

cli.io-next-claim-substeps.profiled-clai.why: Without named rows, a slow claim write gives no evidence about which guard, snapshot, admission, move or checkpoint takes the time.

proves.claim: without PULLBOARD_NEXT_PROFILE, next --take omits profile output and records the normal claim event.

cli.io-next-claim-substeps.default-claim.why: Without a default-path check, claim profiling could leak into ordinary output or change the event a claim records.
